governingFramework: Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 / NPCI Circulars
framework: NPCI Operating Guidelines & Ministry of Finance Directives
sourceTitle: NPCI Circular on Interchange Fee on UPI PPI Merchant Transactions
notes: Per NPCI circular, an interchange fee up to 1.1% applies on merchant transactions conducted via Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI wallets) on UPI for transaction values exceeding ₹2,000. Standard bank account-to-bank account UPI transactions remain at 0% MDR per Ministry of Finance directives. GST on interchange/MDR is 18%.
